generator_seed_rule: crc32 of "METHOD|scheme|variant|fold|box|run_seed|draw" (unsigned), see src/study/study.py gen_seed; variant = geobg for EVAE and main for ADFNE and KDE (internal names kept because they are part of the key)
same_seed_for_all_methods: every method draws its networks with the same run seeds (1337, 20260903, 7) and draws (0-7); only the method name in the key differs
evae_training_seed: each EVAE is trained once per run seed: python, numpy and torch seeded with the run seed (scripts/train_evae.py)
per_network_table: seeds/network_seeds.csv (8640 rows: 120 test-box cases x 3 methods x 24 networks)
ablation: every ablation arm uses the EVAE generator seeds (crc32 of "EVAE|scheme|geobg|fold|box|run_seed|draw") and is trained with the same run seeds; seeds/ablation_network_seeds.csv
